title: Implement semantic version comparison
instruction: Implement compareVersions(a, b) in src/semver.mjs so that it sorts release versions correctly. Return a negative number, 0, or a positive number like a comparator. Versions look like 1.2.3 and may have a pre-release suffix such as 1.2.3-beta.2.
hiddenRequirementsNote: The acceptance tests follow SemVer 2.0.0 precedence exactly (section 11): numeric identifiers compare numerically, alphanumeric identifiers compare lexically in ASCII order, numeric identifiers have lower precedence than alphanumeric ones, a larger set of pre-release fields has higher precedence when all preceding fields are equal, build metadata (+...) is ignored, and invalid versions throw TypeError. The instruction does not spell these out; this task measures whether an arm resolves under-specified requirements towards the named standard and whether review catches gaps.
